MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 27
   C. 25
   D. 17

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 20

8. Solve for x: x + 6 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 14
   D. 6

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

15. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 22

17. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 73

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

19. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

22. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

23. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 24.5
   C. 49
   D. 8

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
